asked.item: Why Reconnect shows the maximum connected accounts error for an existing account
How to get past the error
Which accounts count toward the 20 limit

verdict.reason: The error sentence says Reconnect counts against the account limit and gives the options to free a slot or upgrade.

steps.text: Reconnecting an existing account counts against the same connected-accounts limit, so Reconnect fails until you free a slot.
You can disconnect an account in Accounts, or upgrade your plan.

To upgrade, go to Settings > Billing, click View Billing Portal, click the purple Update subscription button, then select Creator for up to 40 accounts or Agency for up to 100 accounts and confirm the change.
Each connected Facebook Page, each LinkedIn company Page (plus your LinkedIn profile), and each Slack channel counts toward your total.
